caption: The drawing depicts a single, brown, rounded jug with a small spout at the top and a curved handle attached from the spout’s neck to the upper body of the jug. The jug appears to be made of ceramic or clay, as suggested by its smooth surface and earthy coloration. The shading on the jug suggests a light source coming from the left side, resulting in a highlight on the upper left part and a shadowed area on the lower right. The background is a plain, light beige or cream color with no additional objects, patterns, or distractions. At the bottom center of the drawing, the name "CHARLES KEMPTER" is printed in small, uppercase letters. The composition centers the jug, with ample empty space surrounding it.
title: Vinegar Jug
